register_dataset_lvis_instances: register a LVIS dataset in Detectron2 using json annotations and image root directory
load_lvis_json_annotations: load LVIS json annotation file and return dataset records in Detectron2 standard format
get_lvis_instances_meta: get LVIS dataset metadata including thing_classes for a given dataset version
visualize_lvis_dataset: visualize LVIS dataset annotations by drawing bounding boxes and segmentations on images
test_lvis_dataset_loader: test the LVIS json dataset loader by loading annotations and saving visualized images
